decisions.quote: A closer examination of the conﬁguration types reveals both similarities and diﬀerences. ere are parallels between the ﬁndings of the Wiklund and Shepherd study (2005) and the replication for Types 1 and 4 (stable environment/low access to capital; dynamic envi- ronment/high access to capital). For both types, we can conﬁrm the positive eﬀect of EO on business performance, even in the context of a diﬀerent business culture.
decisions.reason: The replication reports both agreement and disagreement with Wiklund and Shepherd (2005): it concurs on rejecting the two-way contingency hypotheses (H2, H3), supporting the three-way configuration interaction (H4a), rejecting H4c, and confirming positive EO effects in configuration Types 1 and 4 (including H4b), while finding a negative rather than positive main effect (H1) and negative EO effects in configuration Types 2 and 3.
